scope: Primary award and creator references for Relay art-direction exploration. No reference assets are redistributed.

evidencePolicy.directionsAre: Authored product hypotheses; neither synthetic critique nor local model choice is human preference evidence.
evidencePolicy.assetPolicy: Links and short paraphrases only in repository. Two primary press/case images inspected in temporary local reference-only storage. No copied images, fonts, meshes, brands or code are supplied to builders.

directions.authoredIntent: Calm dark instrument housing with precise dense plotting fields and small functional light accents.
Mineral light substrate, strong technical ink, restrained industrial diagrams and glazed active controls.

references.creator: Flighty LLC

primarySources.evidence: Names Flighty the Interaction app winner; describes maps, delay forecasting and timely key information.

visualEvidence.inspection: Link verified; screenshot not independently measured in this task.
visualEvidence.rights: Reference only; no reuse license inferred.

authoredTransfer: Keep operational context and the next useful action adjacent to the changing metric.
Let the selected entity persist through summary, detail and diagnostic views.
explicitNonTransfer: No copied flight map, route card, brand assets or exact layout.
Travel utility and an award do not validate observability usability or motion costs.

references.creator: Sherwood Forestry Service

primarySources.evidence: Names Watch Duty the Social Impact app winner; describes clear wildfire updates and emergency context.

visualEvidence.inspection: Award source read; no live app or screenshot measurement claimed.

authoredTransfer: Distinguish event status, update time, affected area/service and operator responsibility.
Never let atmosphere compete with urgent labels or recovery instructions.
explicitNonTransfer: No emergency authority, wildfire data or safety reliability is inherited.
Do not borrow maps, icons, alerts or notification claims.

references.creator: Condor Digital
references.award: Apple Design Award — Visuals and Graphics; Interaction finalist

primarySources.evidence: Names the Visuals and Graphics winner and Interaction finalist; describes charts, custom animation and theme coherence.
Current 2026 winner page corroborates dense weather-data presentation and material/palette integration.

visualEvidence.inspection: Visually inspected in temporary local reference-only storage; image shows repeated charts, compact annotated values and a clearly selected navigation control. No geometry/color/composite measurements claimed.
visualEvidence.rights: No redistribution or reuse license inferred.

authoredTransfer: Use material and plot color as one product-specific system.
Keep data marks and units legible inside subdued panels; reserve a stronger glazed cue for current controls.
explicitNonTransfer: No copied aquatic palette, wave line, Apple Liquid Glass implementation or proprietary assets.
A press screenshot cannot establish actual motion, contrast, accessibility or renderer parity.

references.creator: abeto and Bureaux
references.award: Awwwards Site of the Day and Developer Award

primarySources.evidence: SOTD date and both creators credited; Developer Award also listed.

primarySources.author: abeto
primarySources.evidence: Documents previs, browser iteration, low-end performance checks and a coherent frost/displacement transition treatment.

visualEvidence.inspection: Visually inspected in temporary local reference-only storage. A broad cool light regime, distinct foreground/background depth and luminous material edges are visible; no live performance or optical measurement claimed.
visualEvidence.rights: Source image itself states all rights reserved. Not redistributed.

authoredTransfer: Give multiple finishes a shared light direction and world scale.
Prototype the whole task in the actual renderer and revise expensive details using measured performance.
explicitNonTransfer: No ice geometry, characters, audio, textures, shaders, logo or scene reconstruction.
Do not import scroll-gated content, canvas-only text or an immersive landing-page journey into incident operations.

references.creator: REJOUICE and PROPAGANDE (Awwwards credits)
references.award: Awwwards Site of the Day and Developer Award

primarySources.evidence: SOTD date, creator credits and Developer Award listed.
Rejouice documents brand/art direction, motion/3D visualization and web work around yard-data operations; case page also lists SOTD, Developer and monthly recognition.

visualEvidence.inspection: Award and creator case read. No independent live DOM, motion or performance inspection claimed.
visualEvidence.rights: Reference links only; no media reused.

authoredTransfer: Use precise technical diagrams and strong information grouping to make a complex system inspectable.
Tie expressive motion to a meaningful service/dependency relationship rather than a generic entrance effect.
explicitNonTransfer: No logistics claims, brand copy, yard imagery, models, typefaces or exact industrial page layout.
A marketing case study does not prove dense operational app behavior or native performance.

limitations: No controlled human preference study or quantitative extraction from these references was performed.
Award facts and creator process claims are attributed, not converted into universal design equations.
Lusion/Shopify/Siena Awwwards pages timed out during this research; secondary claims were excluded from the selected reference set.
The 2026 current award page can change; dated Newsroom pages anchor award history.
